title: 100 jaar De Stijl placeholder page
lede: A one-screen holding page for the 2017 centenary whose logo spells “100 JAAR DE STIJL” in square-built letters in red, yellow, blue, gray, and black.
summary: Rectilinear square-built logo lettering in primaries and black on an otherwise plain white page.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 from the Wayback Machine copy of 23 November 2021 and inspected. A 2017 copy was requested; the archive returned the 2021 capture.

notice: This is an archived copy. The page says the site was still in development, and it links to an official national website elsewhere.

styles.note: Borderline: the logo follows van Doesburg’s rectilinear alphabet and the primary palette, but the rest of the page is a plain centered holding page.

observed: The page is white with centered small text: “deze site is in ontwikkeling” and the dates “1917 - 2017”.
The logo spells “100 JAAR” and “DE STIJL” in letters built from square strokes and right angles; the numerals are red, yellow, and blue, the other letters gray and black.
Below are an e-mail link, three black social icons, and a footer between two thin gray rules that credits Manschot Grafimedia, Zeist.
interpretation: The logo is the only part in the style, and it is an image, so the measurement sees only the centered Gill Sans text (1 hue, no borders).
borrow: Build a wordmark from square strokes on a grid, and color only a few letters with the primaries.

images.alt: Mostly white web page with a centered logo reading 100 JAAR DE STIJL in square-built letters, the numerals in red, yellow, and blue and the other letters in gray and black, above an e-mail link and social icons.
images.caption: Archived copy of [100jaardestijl.nl](https://web.archive.org/web/20211123002619/http://100jaardestijl.nl/), 23 November 2021.
